Introduction

Jeong Ichan, also known as Jeong Echan, is a South Korean singer and music producer under HYPLE Entertainment. As a trainee, he is known for appearing and competing in the suvival show "I-LAND" under the name Jaebeom and Boys Planet under the name Ichan. He made his official debut on June 23, 2022 with the digital single "Eternal Summer."
